items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And you listen to him on Unity and Woody was figuring it out. Then you put the records on and the solos, you know, kind of like the way Clifford Brown used to play, not as fluid in that direction.

ctx.x: Today is May 24, 2012 and this is the Smithsonian Oral History Interview with saxophonist, composer, bandleader, educator, radio and TV personality and erstwhile thespian, or actor, NEA Jazz Master Branford Marsalis in his home in Durham, North Carolina. Good morning Mr. Marsalis, how are you doing?
Good morning, Mr. Brown. How are you?
OK. If we can go ahead and forgo the formalities if I may call you Branford, you can call me whatever you want.
